{
  "action_type": "execute",
  "operation": "check_contig_compatibility",
  "purpose": "validation",
  "argv": [
    "bash",
    "-lc",
    "set -euo pipefail
vcf="/public/home/liusiqi/03.毕设/benchmarks/01.测试/04.重测序/Part2.vairant_annotation/data/all.filtered.snp.vcf"
fasta="/public/home/liusiqi/03.毕设/benchmarks/01.测试/04.重测序/Part2.vairant_annotation/data/genome.fasta"
gtf="/public/home/liusiqi/03.毕设/benchmarks/01.测试/04.重测序/Part2.vairant_annotation/data/genome.gtf"

vcf_contigs=$(grep -v '^#' "$vcf" | cut -f1 | sort -u)
fasta_contigs=$(grep '^>' "$fasta" | sed 's/^>//' | cut -d' ' -f1 | sort -u)
gtf_contigs=$(awk -F'\t' '!/^#/ && NF>=1 {print $1}' "$gtf" | sort -u)

missing_in_fasta=$(comm -23 <(printf '%s\n' "$vcf_contigs") <(printf '%s\n' "$fasta_contigs"))
missing_in_gtf=$(comm -23 <(printf '%s\n' "$vcf_contigs") <(printf '%s\n' "$gtf_contigs"))

compatible=true
if [ -n "$missing_in_fasta" ] || [ -n "$missing_in_gtf" ]; then
  compatible=false
fi

printf 'VCF contigs: %s\n' "$(printf '%s\n' "$vcf_contigs" | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//')"
printf 'FASTA contigs: %s\n' "$(printf '%s\n' "$fasta_contigs" | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//')"
printf 'GTF contigs: %s\n' "$(printf '%s\n' "$gtf_contigs" | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//')"
printf 'VCF contigs missing in FASTA: %s\n' "$(printf '%s\n' "$missing_in_fasta" | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//')"
printf 'VCF contigs missing in GTF: %s\n' "$(printf '%s\n' "$missing_in_gtf" | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//')"
printf 'BIOMIND_EFFECT_EVIDENCE_JSON={"produces_observations":[{"observation_id":"contigs_compatible","value":%s}]}\n' "$compatible"
"
  ],
  "env": {}
}
